title: 潛盾機刀具磨耗管理~TBM cutter-wear management
focus: 以刀具軌跡、接觸荷重與磨耗證據解釋掘進刀具壽命~Explain cutter life using trajectories, contact loads and wear evidence
summary: 本課聚焦以刀具軌跡、接觸荷重與磨耗證據解釋掘進刀具壽命。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。~This course focuses on explain cutter life using trajectories, contact loads and wear evidence. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.

units.anchor: 刀具半徑與行程~Cutter radius and travel
units.title: 刀具半徑與行程~Cutter radius and travel
units.mechanism: 不同半徑刀具每轉走過不同距離，外緣刀即使承受相同轉數也有較長接觸路徑。磨耗比較須規一化里程或體積並保留刀位，不能用更換次數直接推斷材料品質。 假設刀位半徑5 m、轉速4 rpm，切向速度v=2πrn/60=2.094 m/s；不代表建議轉速。 把外緣刀較快磨耗全歸於材料缺陷會錯判供應品質，刀位更換後仍沿用舊行程又會污染趨勢；壽命模型因此對下一段地層失去可比性。~Tools at different radii travel different distances per revolution. Outer cutters therefore accumulate longer contact paths at equal revolutions, requiring wear normalization by travel or excavation and retention of cutter position rather than replacement count alone. Assume cutter radius 5 m and rotation 4 rpm; tangential speed v=2πrn/60=2.094 m/s, not a recommended speed. Attributing faster outer wear solely to material defects misjudges quality, while retaining old travel after relocation corrupts trends. The resulting life model loses comparability for the next geological reach.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設刀位半徑5 m、轉速4 rpm，切向速度v=2πrn/60=2.094 m/s；不代表建議轉速。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume cutter radius 5 m and rotation 4 rpm; tangential speed v=2πrn/60=2.094 m/s, not a recommended speed.
units.verify: 以刀位圖、轉數及地層日誌計算接觸行程，對照同類刀具的量測磨耗；將外緣與中心刀分組比較，無法追溯位置的磨耗資料不得直接用於壽命排名。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把外緣刀較快磨耗全歸於材料缺陷會錯判供應品質，刀位更換後仍沿用舊行程又會污染趨勢；壽命模型因此對下一段地層失去可比性。~Combine cutter map, revolutions and geology to calculate travel and compare measured wear for like tools; group outer and center positions separately and do not rank life from records lacking position traceability. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Attributing faster outer wear solely to material defects misjudges quality, while retaining old travel after relocation corrupts trends. The resulting life model loses comparability for the next geological reach.
units.failure: 把外緣刀較快磨耗全歸於材料缺陷會錯判供應品質，刀位更換後仍沿用舊行程又會污染趨勢；壽命模型因此對下一段地層失去可比性。~Attributing faster outer wear solely to material defects misjudges quality, while retaining old travel after relocation corrupts trends. The resulting life model loses comparability for the next geological reach.
units.misconception: 所有刀位轉數相同時，接觸行程和磨耗需求也完全相同。~Equal revolutions give identical contact travel and wear demand at every cutter position.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄刀具半徑與行程的資料來源與適用條件。以刀位圖、轉數及地層日誌計算接觸行程，對照同類刀具的量測磨耗；將外緣與中心刀分組比較，無法追溯位置的磨耗資料不得直接用於壽命排名。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for cutter radius and travel. Combine cutter map, revolutions and geology to calculate travel and compare measured wear for like tools; group outer and center positions separately and do not rank life from records lacking position traceability.

units.anchor: 貫入與每轉進尺~Penetration per revolution
units.title: 貫入與每轉進尺~Penetration per revolution
units.mechanism: 每轉進尺把推進速率與轉速連結，反映刀具每次通過的切入尺度，但它也受岩體裂隙與刀具間距影響。高進尺未必代表高效率，過大載重可能使刀環或軸承提早失效。 假設推進30 mm/min、轉速3 rpm，每轉進尺p=10 mm/rev；未提供刀具容許荷重。 轉速讀值或里程時間不一致會製造假高進尺，軟弱帶自然崩解也可能看似切削優秀；若據此增加荷重，進入硬岩後可能超出刀具能力。~Penetration per revolution links advance and rotation to cutting scale, but also depends on fractures and spacing. High penetration is not automatically efficient if excessive load damages cutter rings or bearings prematurely. Assume advance 30 mm/min and rotation 3 rpm; penetration p=10 mm/rev, without specifying allowable cutter load. Unsynchronized speed and distance create false high penetration, while weak-ground disintegration can mimic excellent cutting. Increasing load on that evidence may exceed tool capability when harder ground returns.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設推進30 mm/min、轉速3 rpm，每轉進尺p=10 mm/rev；未提供刀具容許荷重。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume advance 30 mm/min and rotation 3 rpm; penetration p=10 mm/rev, without specifying allowable cutter load.
units.verify: 同步推進、轉速、推力與扭矩，將相同地層與刀具狀態下的區段比較；刀具工程師需核對載重範圍與振動，不能只以提高每轉進尺作績效目標。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：轉速讀值或里程時間不一致會製造假高進尺，軟弱帶自然崩解也可能看似切削優秀；若據此增加荷重，進入硬岩後可能超出刀具能力。~Synchronize advance, rotation, thrust and torque and compare intervals with similar geology and tool condition; cutter engineers check loads and vibration instead of treating greater penetration per revolution as the sole performance objective. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Unsynchronized speed and distance create false high penetration, while weak-ground disintegration can mimic excellent cutting. Increasing load on that evidence may exceed tool capability when harder ground returns.
units.failure: 轉速讀值或里程時間不一致會製造假高進尺，軟弱帶自然崩解也可能看似切削優秀；若據此增加荷重，進入硬岩後可能超出刀具能力。~Unsynchronized speed and distance create false high penetration, while weak-ground disintegration can mimic excellent cutting. Increasing load on that evidence may exceed tool capability when harder ground returns.
units.misconception: 每轉進尺越大就必定代表切削效率和刀具壽命越好。~Greater penetration per revolution necessarily improves cutting efficiency and cutter life.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄貫入與每轉進尺的資料來源與適用條件。同步推進、轉速、推力與扭矩，將相同地層與刀具狀態下的區段比較；刀具工程師需核對載重範圍與振動，不能只以提高每轉進尺作績效目標。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for penetration per revolution. Synchronize advance, rotation, thrust and torque and compare intervals with similar geology and tool condition; cutter engineers check loads and vibration instead of treating greater penetration per revolution as the sole performance objective.

units.anchor: 推力分配與偏載~Thrust distribution and uneven loading
units.title: 推力分配與偏載~Thrust distribution and uneven loading
units.mechanism: 總推力包含刀具切削、盾體摩擦及其他阻力，除以刀具數只是粗略平均。混合面與刀盤變形會造成偏載，真正限制可能是單刀峰值而非平均，所以需要位置與工況證據。 假設扣除非切削阻力後有效推力10 MN分到40刀，平均250 kN/刀；不等於每刀實際受力。 少數刀先接觸硬塊時可能承受高衝擊而平均推力正常，若忽略偏載便無法解釋局部刀環崩裂；盲目增加總推力可能使問題惡化。~Total thrust includes cutting, shield friction and other resistance, making division by cutter count only a rough mean. Mixed ground and cutterhead deformation create uneven loads, with individual peaks potentially governing instead of the average. Assume effective cutting thrust 10 MN after removing other resistance, shared by 40 tools; the mean is 250 kN/tool, not each tool's actual load. A few tools meeting a hard inclusion can suffer high impact with normal mean thrust. Ignoring uneven loading leaves localized ring fracture unexplained and may worsen it through increased total thrust.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設扣除非切削阻力後有效推力10 MN分到40刀，平均250 kN/刀；不等於每刀實際受力。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume effective cutting thrust 10 MN after removing other resistance, shared by 40 tools; the mean is 250 kN/tool, not each tool's actual load.
units.verify: 核對總推力與摩擦估算，結合刀位、混合面和可用單刀量測檢查偏載；分析報告列明平均值用途和未量測峰值，不把均分模型當作所有刀具符合能力的證明。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：少數刀先接觸硬塊時可能承受高衝擊而平均推力正常，若忽略偏載便無法解釋局部刀環崩裂；盲目增加總推力可能使問題惡化。~Check thrust and friction estimates against cutter positions, mixed-face geometry and available individual measurements; state the mean's limited use and unresolved peaks instead of treating equal sharing as proof of adequate capacity everywhere. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: A few tools meeting a hard inclusion can suffer high impact with normal mean thrust. Ignoring uneven loading leaves localized ring fracture unexplained and may worsen it through increased total thrust.
units.failure: 少數刀先接觸硬塊時可能承受高衝擊而平均推力正常，若忽略偏載便無法解釋局部刀環崩裂；盲目增加總推力可能使問題惡化。~A few tools meeting a hard inclusion can suffer high impact with normal mean thrust. Ignoring uneven loading leaves localized ring fracture unexplained and may worsen it through increased total thrust.
units.misconception: 總推力除刀具數就能得到每顆刀實際承受的峰值荷重。~Total thrust divided by cutter count gives each cutter's actual peak load.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄推力分配與偏載的資料來源與適用條件。核對總推力與摩擦估算，結合刀位、混合面和可用單刀量測檢查偏載；分析報告列明平均值用途和未量測峰值，不把均分模型當作所有刀具符合能力的證明。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for thrust distribution and uneven loading. Check thrust and friction estimates against cutter positions, mixed-face geometry and available individual measurements; state the mean's limited use and unresolved peaks instead of treating equal sharing as proof of adequate capacity everywhere.

units.anchor: 切削比能與條件~Specific cutting energy and conditions
units.title: 切削比能與條件~Specific cutting energy and conditions
units.mechanism: 扭矩功除以開挖體積得到旋轉比能，可比較破岩代價但不包含全部系統能耗。磨耗、節理及運碴再研磨都會影響它，必須將機械狀態和地質相符的區段放在一起比較。 假設平均扭矩2 MN·m、轉10圈、開挖20 m³，E=2πTn/V=6.283 MJ/m³，僅旋轉部分。 運碴不良造成重複碾碎會抬高比能，若誤當岩石變硬便可能錯調推力；出土體積估錯又讓能量指標看似改善而實際效率下降。~Rotational work per excavated volume measures cutting cost but excludes other system energy. Wear, joints and regrinding affect it, requiring matched geological and mechanical conditions for meaningful comparisons. Assume mean torque 2 MN·m, 10 revolutions and excavation 20 m³; E=2πTn/V=6.283 MJ/m³ for rotation only. Poor muck removal raises energy through regrinding and may be misread as harder rock. Incorrect excavated volume can conversely make the energy index appear better while actual efficiency deteriorates.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設平均扭矩2 MN·m、轉10圈、開挖20 m³，E=2πTn/V=6.283 MJ/m³，僅旋轉部分。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume mean torque 2 MN·m, 10 revolutions and excavation 20 m³; E=2πTn/V=6.283 MJ/m³ for rotation only.
units.verify: 將扭矩積分與實測開挖體積核對，標記停機、空轉及換刀，對照碴片尺寸與地質；比能突升先查多種成因，再由刀具與地工人員決定是否需要獨立檢查。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：運碴不良造成重複碾碎會抬高比能，若誤當岩石變硬便可能錯調推力；出土體積估錯又讓能量指標看似改善而實際效率下降。~Check integrated torque work against measured excavation volume and mark stops, idle rotation and replacements; compare chips and geology and investigate competing causes before cutter and geotechnical specialists select further checks. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Poor muck removal raises energy through regrinding and may be misread as harder rock. Incorrect excavated volume can conversely make the energy index appear better while actual efficiency deteriorates.
units.failure: 運碴不良造成重複碾碎會抬高比能，若誤當岩石變硬便可能錯調推力；出土體積估錯又讓能量指標看似改善而實際效率下降。~Poor muck removal raises energy through regrinding and may be misread as harder rock. Incorrect excavated volume can conversely make the energy index appear better while actual efficiency deteriorates.
units.misconception: 旋轉比能增加只能由岩石變硬造成，與排碴無關。~Higher rotational specific energy can only come from harder rock, never muck removal.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄切削比能與條件的資料來源與適用條件。將扭矩積分與實測開挖體積核對，標記停機、空轉及換刀，對照碴片尺寸與地質；比能突升先查多種成因，再由刀具與地工人員決定是否需要獨立檢查。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for specific cutting energy and conditions. Check integrated torque work against measured excavation volume and mark stops, idle rotation and replacements; compare chips and geology and investigate competing causes before cutter and geotechnical specialists select further checks.

units.anchor: 磨耗率與地層分段~Wear rate by geological reach
units.title: 磨耗率與地層分段~Wear rate by geological reach
units.mechanism: 刀環徑向損失反映磨蝕，但壽命並非沿全程固定線性；礦物、顆粒與含水改變會使速率跳變。計算前需把更換和刀位移動分開，且保留接近極限時的非線性劣化可能。 假設徑向磨耗3 mm歷經600 m，平均0.005 mm/m；此率不能無條件外推到下一岩層。 跨岩性平均會低估磨蝕帶的即時消耗，量具基準改變又會製造假回復；錯誤壽命預估可能讓需要計畫檢查的刀具過晚被辨識。~Radial loss measures abrasion, but life is not uniformly linear along a drive. Mineralogy, grains and water change rates abruptly. Separate replacements and relocation and retain the possibility of accelerated deterioration near a limiting condition. Assume radial wear 3 mm over 600 m; mean rate is 0.005 mm/m, not transferable unconditionally to the next stratum. Averaging across lithologies understates current wear in an abrasive band, while changed measuring datums create false recovery. The resulting life estimate identifies tools requiring planned inspection too late.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設徑向磨耗3 mm歷經600 m，平均0.005 mm/m；此率不能無條件外推到下一岩層。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume radial wear 3 mm over 600 m; mean rate is 0.005 mm/m, not transferable unconditionally to the next stratum.
units.verify: 用一致量具和基準量測刀環，將磨耗對里程、轉數和岩性分段圖示；比較相似刀位與材料，壽命外推需由刀具工程師說明穩態假設，不能以全程平均掩蓋短高磨耗區。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：跨岩性平均會低估磨蝕帶的即時消耗，量具基準改變又會製造假回復；錯誤壽命預估可能讓需要計畫檢查的刀具過晚被辨識。~Measure with consistent gauges and datum and plot wear against chainage, revolutions and geology; compare like positions and materials and require engineers to justify steady-rate extrapolation rather than hide a short severe zone in a route average. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Averaging across lithologies understates current wear in an abrasive band, while changed measuring datums create false recovery. The resulting life estimate identifies tools requiring planned inspection too late.
units.failure: 跨岩性平均會低估磨蝕帶的即時消耗，量具基準改變又會製造假回復；錯誤壽命預估可能讓需要計畫檢查的刀具過晚被辨識。~Averaging across lithologies understates current wear in an abrasive band, while changed measuring datums create false recovery. The resulting life estimate identifies tools requiring planned inspection too late.
units.misconception: 前一岩層的平均磨耗率可以無條件預測下一岩層壽命。~The previous stratum's mean wear rate predicts life in the next stratum unconditionally.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄磨耗率與地層分段的資料來源與適用條件。用一致量具和基準量測刀環，將磨耗對里程、轉數和岩性分段圖示；比較相似刀位與材料，壽命外推需由刀具工程師說明穩態假設，不能以全程平均掩蓋短高磨耗區。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for wear rate by geological reach. Measure with consistent gauges and datum and plot wear against chainage, revolutions and geology; compare like positions and materials and require engineers to justify steady-rate extrapolation rather than hide a short severe zone in a route average.

units.anchor: 刀環磨耗與軸承故障~Ring wear and bearing failure
units.title: 刀環磨耗與軸承故障~Ring wear and bearing failure
units.mechanism: 刀環磨耗是接觸表面的漸進損失，軸承故障則可能使刀具停止滾動並產生滑磨，兩者症狀不同。溫度、聲振和磨耗形態需要合併，不能只量剩餘直徑就判斷可用性。 假設正常溫度40°C、觀測65°C，升幅25 K；此差只供教學診斷，不是通用軸承警戒值。 卡死刀具會由滾動變滑動，局部發熱和刀環損失加速，總扭矩初期卻未必明顯；只靠平均刀盤訊號可能漏掉早期單刀故障。~Ring wear is gradual surface loss, whereas bearing failure can stop rotation and create sliding abrasion. Temperature, vibration and wear shape are complementary, and remaining diameter alone cannot establish tool condition. Assume normal temperature 40°C and observation 65°C; the rise is 25 K, a diagnostic illustration rather than a universal bearing alarm. A seized tool slides rather than rolls, accelerating heat and local wear while total torque may initially change little. Average cutterhead signals can therefore miss the early failure of one cutter.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設正常溫度40°C、觀測65°C，升幅25 K；此差只供教學診斷，不是通用軸承警戒值。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume normal temperature 40°C and observation 65°C; the rise is 25 K, a diagnostic illustration rather than a universal bearing alarm.
units.verify: 比較同工況刀具的溫度與振動基線，檢查平磨面、偏磨及轉動狀態的核准檢查紀錄；設備主管需區分散熱環境和軸承異常，所有接近刀盤檢查遵守專業安全程序。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：卡死刀具會由滾動變滑動，局部發熱和刀環損失加速，總扭矩初期卻未必明顯；只靠平均刀盤訊號可能漏掉早期單刀故障。~Compare temperature and vibration baselines under matched conditions with approved records of flat spots, uneven wear and rotation; equipment leads distinguish cooling changes from bearing faults, with cutterhead access restricted to specialist procedures. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: A seized tool slides rather than rolls, accelerating heat and local wear while total torque may initially change little. Average cutterhead signals can therefore miss the early failure of one cutter.
units.failure: 卡死刀具會由滾動變滑動，局部發熱和刀環損失加速，總扭矩初期卻未必明顯；只靠平均刀盤訊號可能漏掉早期單刀故障。~A seized tool slides rather than rolls, accelerating heat and local wear while total torque may initially change little. Average cutterhead signals can therefore miss the early failure of one cutter.
units.misconception: 刀環剩餘直徑足夠就證明軸承和轉動狀態也正常。~Adequate remaining ring diameter proves that bearings and rotation are also healthy.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄刀環磨耗與軸承故障的資料來源與適用條件。比較同工況刀具的溫度與振動基線，檢查平磨面、偏磨及轉動狀態的核准檢查紀錄；設備主管需區分散熱環境和軸承異常，所有接近刀盤檢查遵守專業安全程序。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for ring wear and bearing failure. Compare temperature and vibration baselines under matched conditions with approved records of flat spots, uneven wear and rotation; equipment leads distinguish cooling changes from bearing faults, with cutterhead access restricted to specialist procedures.

units.anchor: 衝擊與混合面循環~Impact and mixed-face cycling
units.title: 衝擊與混合面循環~Impact and mixed-face cycling
units.mechanism: 刀具每轉穿越硬軟界面會反覆載入卸載，平均力無法代表疲勞與衝擊。界面位置、硬塊尺寸和旋轉速度共同控制循環數與幅值，需把事件和刀位路徑對齊。 假設每轉有2次硬軟轉換、轉速3 rpm、持續100 h，轉換次數2×3×60×100=36000次。 取樣頻率不足會把衝擊平均掉，刀具卻持續承受疲勞；只統計轉數又忽略硬軟界面轉換，可能誤把局部崩裂當成偶然製造缺陷。~Crossing a hard-soft interface repeatedly loads and unloads a tool. Mean force cannot represent fatigue and impact; interface position, inclusion size and rotation together control cycling, requiring events to be aligned with cutter trajectories. Assume 2 transitions per revolution at 3 rpm over 100 h; transition count is 2×3×60×100=36000. Slow sampling averages impacts away while fatigue continues. Counting revolutions without interface crossings may wrongly classify localized chipping as a random manufacturing defect rather than repeated loading.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設每轉有2次硬軟轉換、轉速3 rpm、持續100 h，轉換次數2×3×60×100=36000次。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume 2 transitions per revolution at 3 rpm over 100 h; transition count is 2×3×60×100=36000.
units.verify: 利用地質面形與旋轉訊號對照週期性衝擊，保留高頻資料而非僅班平均；刀具工程師依實際載荷幅和材料資料評估損傷，循環數本身不能換成未經驗證的剩餘壽命。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：取樣頻率不足會把衝擊平均掉，刀具卻持續承受疲勞；只統計轉數又忽略硬軟界面轉換，可能誤把局部崩裂當成偶然製造缺陷。~Compare face geometry with rotation-synchronized impacts and retain high-frequency records rather than shift means; specialists assess damage using actual amplitudes and material data, not cycle count alone as an unvalidated remaining-life prediction. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Slow sampling averages impacts away while fatigue continues. Counting revolutions without interface crossings may wrongly classify localized chipping as a random manufacturing defect rather than repeated loading.
units.failure: 取樣頻率不足會把衝擊平均掉，刀具卻持續承受疲勞；只統計轉數又忽略硬軟界面轉換，可能誤把局部崩裂當成偶然製造缺陷。~Slow sampling averages impacts away while fatigue continues. Counting revolutions without interface crossings may wrongly classify localized chipping as a random manufacturing defect rather than repeated loading.
units.misconception: 班平均扭矩正常就表示沒有局部刀具衝擊疲勞。~Normal shift-average torque means no localized cutter impact fatigue is occurring.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄衝擊與混合面循環的資料來源與適用條件。利用地質面形與旋轉訊號對照週期性衝擊，保留高頻資料而非僅班平均；刀具工程師依實際載荷幅和材料資料評估損傷，循環數本身不能換成未經驗證的剩餘壽命。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for impact and mixed-face cycling. Compare face geometry with rotation-synchronized impacts and retain high-frequency records rather than shift means; specialists assess damage using actual amplitudes and material data, not cycle count alone as an unvalidated remaining-life prediction.

units.anchor: 刀間距與碴片形成~Cutter spacing and chip formation
units.title: 刀間距與碴片形成~Cutter spacing and chip formation
units.mechanism: 相鄰刀槽之間的裂縫若能連通，岩石以較大碴片剝離；間距、貫入與岩性不匹配時會變成重複研磨。幾何比只描述相對尺度，不能不經試驗就轉成通用最佳刀間距。 假設刀間距80 mm、貫入10 mm，比值s/p=8；相同比值在不同岩性不保證相同比能。 粉碴增加可能表示研磨、磨鈍或岩性改變，不能一律歸於間距不當；若只追求大碴片也可能忽略排碴能力和混合面衝擊的限制。~Connected cracks between neighboring tracks release larger chips, while mismatched spacing, penetration and rock behavior promote regrinding. A geometry ratio describes relative scale without establishing a universal optimum spacing absent testing. For assumed spacing 80 mm and penetration 10 mm, s/p=8; the same ratio in different rocks does not guarantee equal specific energy. More fines may indicate regrinding, blunt tools or changed geology rather than spacing alone. Maximizing chip size can also neglect muck-handling capacity and impact limitations in mixed ground.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設刀間距80 mm、貫入10 mm，比值s/p=8；相同比值在不同岩性不保證相同比能。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed spacing 80 mm and penetration 10 mm, s/p=8; the same ratio in different rocks does not guarantee equal specific energy.
units.verify: 對照代表岩樣切削試驗、碴片粒徑與實際刀盤配置，記錄岩體節理影響；幾何變更由設計和刀具團隊評估，不能從算例比值直接要求現場改裝刀盤。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：粉碴增加可能表示研磨、磨鈍或岩性改變，不能一律歸於間距不當；若只追求大碴片也可能忽略排碴能力和混合面衝擊的限制。~Compare representative cutting tests, chip sizes and actual cutter layout while documenting joints; design and tool teams assess geometry changes, and the example ratio must not directly drive a field cutterhead modification. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: More fines may indicate regrinding, blunt tools or changed geology rather than spacing alone. Maximizing chip size can also neglect muck-handling capacity and impact limitations in mixed ground.
units.failure: 粉碴增加可能表示研磨、磨鈍或岩性改變，不能一律歸於間距不當；若只追求大碴片也可能忽略排碴能力和混合面衝擊的限制。~More fines may indicate regrinding, blunt tools or changed geology rather than spacing alone. Maximizing chip size can also neglect muck-handling capacity and impact limitations in mixed ground.
units.misconception: 相同刀間距貫入比在所有岩性都會有同樣最佳切削效果。~The same spacing-penetration ratio gives identical optimum cutting in every rock type.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄刀間距與碴片形成的資料來源與適用條件。對照代表岩樣切削試驗、碴片粒徑與實際刀盤配置，記錄岩體節理影響；幾何變更由設計和刀具團隊評估，不能從算例比值直接要求現場改裝刀盤。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for cutter spacing and chip formation. Compare representative cutting tests, chip sizes and actual cutter layout while documenting joints; design and tool teams assess geometry changes, and the example ratio must not directly drive a field cutterhead modification.

units.anchor: 刀具身份與維修追溯~Tool identity and maintenance traceability
units.title: 刀具身份與維修追溯~Tool identity and maintenance traceability
units.mechanism: 同一刀具可能在不同位置使用並經維修，序號、刀位與時間共同決定實際歷程。更換刀環不一定重置軸承壽命，資料庫必須分辨組件層級，否則新舊零件會混成同一壽命樣本。 假設刀環使用400 h更換、軸承此前已200 h，若軸承未換則累積600 h，不是400 h或零。 序號抄錯會把早期故障歸到另一批次，更換整刀與只換刀環未區分則誇大或低估壽命；供應比較和備件計畫都會被錯誤歷程影響。~A tool may be relocated and rebuilt, making serial number, position and time jointly essential. Replacing a ring does not necessarily reset bearing life; component-level records prevent new and old parts being combined as one lifetime sample. Assume a ring is replaced after 400 h while its bearing already had 200 h; an unchanged bearing has accumulated 600 h, not 400 h or zero. A wrong serial assigns early failure to the wrong batch, while conflating complete-tool and ring-only replacement distorts life. Supplier comparisons and spare planning then inherit the same erroneous history.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設刀環使用400 h更換、軸承此前已200 h，若軸承未換則累積600 h，不是400 h或零。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume a ring is replaced after 400 h while its bearing already had 200 h; an unchanged bearing has accumulated 600 h, not 400 h or zero.
units.verify: 抽查刀位圖與序號、維修單、照片和量測紀錄能否互相連接，重建組件累積里程；資料負責人與維修主管共同確認重置規則，缺失歷程需標示不確定而非補寫理想值。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：序號抄錯會把早期故障歸到另一批次，更換整刀與只換刀環未區分則誇大或低估壽命；供應比較和備件計畫都會被錯誤歷程影響。~Audit links among cutter map, serials, maintenance sheets, photographs and measurements and reconstruct component exposure; data and maintenance leads approve reset rules, flagging missing history instead of filling it with idealized values. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: A wrong serial assigns early failure to the wrong batch, while conflating complete-tool and ring-only replacement distorts life. Supplier comparisons and spare planning then inherit the same erroneous history.
units.failure: 序號抄錯會把早期故障歸到另一批次，更換整刀與只換刀環未區分則誇大或低估壽命；供應比較和備件計畫都會被錯誤歷程影響。~A wrong serial assigns early failure to the wrong batch, while conflating complete-tool and ring-only replacement distorts life. Supplier comparisons and spare planning then inherit the same erroneous history.
units.misconception: 只更換刀環就可以把未更換軸承的累積使用時間歸零。~Replacing only the ring resets accumulated service time of the unchanged bearing.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄刀具身份與維修追溯的資料來源與適用條件。抽查刀位圖與序號、維修單、照片和量測紀錄能否互相連接，重建組件累積里程；資料負責人與維修主管共同確認重置規則，缺失歷程需標示不確定而非補寫理想值。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for tool identity and maintenance traceability. Audit links among cutter map, serials, maintenance sheets, photographs and measurements and reconstruct component exposure; data and maintenance leads approve reset rules, flagging missing history instead of filling it with idealized values.

units.anchor: 維護決策與檢查界線~Maintenance decisions and access boundaries
units.title: 維護決策與檢查界線~Maintenance decisions and access boundaries
units.mechanism: 刀具維護需整合剩餘厚度、軸承狀態、預測地層與可檢查窗口，不能由單一磨耗率自動決定。資料驅動判讀只支持專業決策，刀盤或加壓艙的接近仍是獨立的高風險核准工作。 假設40刀中36刀有最新有效狀態，覆蓋90%；其餘4刀若位於同一高負荷區，不能以整體比例忽略。 只按平均磨耗安排檢查可能漏掉一顆卡死刀具，預測模型若未更新新岩層也會過度樂觀；忽略這些限制會讓規劃數字被誤當現場許可。~Maintenance combines remaining section, bearing condition, predicted ground and inspection opportunities rather than one wear rate. Data supports professional decisions, while access to a cutterhead or pressurized chamber remains a separately approved specialist task. If 36 of an assumed 40 cutters have current valid condition records, coverage is 90%; 4 missing tools in a high-load zone cannot be dismissed by the overall percentage. Average-wear scheduling can miss one seized tool, and an unupdated ground model gives optimistic forecasts. Ignoring these limits can turn planning numbers into mistakenly assumed authorization for field work.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設40刀中36刀有最新有效狀態，覆蓋90%；其餘4刀若位於同一高負荷區，不能以整體比例忽略。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If 36 of an assumed 40 cutters have current valid condition records, coverage is 90%; 4 missing tools in a high-load zone cannot be dismissed by the overall percentage.
units.verify: 以刀位風險圖核對資料新鮮度、地質預測和維護紀錄，將未確認刀具單列；維修及施工負責人依核准計畫安排檢查，課程不提供進艙、換刀或解除隔離的操作步驟。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：只按平均磨耗安排檢查可能漏掉一顆卡死刀具，預測模型若未更新新岩層也會過度樂觀；忽略這些限制會讓規劃數字被誤當現場許可。~Review data freshness, ground prediction and maintenance on a position-risk map, listing unconfirmed tools; maintenance and construction leads plan inspections under approved arrangements, with no chamber-entry or tool-change procedure supplied here. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Average-wear scheduling can miss one seized tool, and an unupdated ground model gives optimistic forecasts. Ignoring these limits can turn planning numbers into mistakenly assumed authorization for field work.
units.failure: 只按平均磨耗安排檢查可能漏掉一顆卡死刀具，預測模型若未更新新岩層也會過度樂觀；忽略這些限制會讓規劃數字被誤當現場許可。~Average-wear scheduling can miss one seized tool, and an unupdated ground model gives optimistic forecasts. Ignoring these limits can turn planning numbers into mistakenly assumed authorization for field work.
units.misconception: 刀具平均磨耗很低就能排除任何單刀卡死風險。~Low average cutter wear excludes any possibility of one seized cutter.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄維護決策與檢查界線的資料來源與適用條件。以刀位風險圖核對資料新鮮度、地質預測和維護紀錄，將未確認刀具單列；維修及施工負責人依核准計畫安排檢查，課程不提供進艙、換刀或解除隔離的操作步驟。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for maintenance decisions and access boundaries. Review data freshness, ground prediction and maintenance on a position-risk map, listing unconfirmed tools; maintenance and construction leads plan inspections under approved arrangements, with no chamber-entry or tool-change procedure supplied here.

example: 原創教學算例，所有輸入是為比較機制而假設，並非任何地標的實測資料。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設刀位半徑5 m、轉速4 rpm，切向速度v=2πrn/60=2.094 m/s；不代表建議轉速。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設推進30 mm/min、轉速3 rpm，每轉進尺p=10 mm/rev；未提供刀具容許荷重。將第一式的一個線性乘數加倍而固定其他邊界，該項貢獻隨之加倍；若為非線性式則必須重新代入，不能等比例外推。把輸入值、單位換算、計算結果及假設列成四欄，再用獨立計算器重算；最後比較量測誤差與模型簡化，判斷改變是否足以支持工程決策。~Original teaching example: all inputs are assumptions for comparing mechanisms, not measurements from a landmark project. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume cutter radius 5 m and rotation 4 rpm; tangential speed v=2πrn/60=2.094 m/s, not a recommended speed. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume advance 30 mm/min and rotation 3 rpm; penetration p=10 mm/rev, without specifying allowable cutter load. Doubling one linear multiplicative input in the first relation while holding the remaining boundaries fixed doubles that contribution; a nonlinear relation must instead be evaluated again. Tabulate inputs, unit conversions, results and assumptions in separate columns, and recalculate independently. Finally compare measurement uncertainty with model simplification before deciding whether the difference supports an engineering decision.
history: 美國聯邦公路管理局於2009年發行公路隧道土建技術手冊，整理調查與土建工程的公開原理；瑞士官方介紹聖哥達基線隧道長57公里並於2016年投入營運，提供深埋長隧道的工程環境對照。Crossrail於2017年公開完工後地質縱剖面，提醒讀者鑽孔密度、偏離隧道位置與簡化斷層會限制推論。這些出版節點顯示以刀具軌跡、接觸荷重與磨耗證據解釋掘進刀具壽命需要把原始紀錄和模型分開保存；地標僅供工程環境比較，本課只重建公開原理。~FHWA issued its civil-elements road-tunnel manual in 2009, collecting public investigation and civil-engineering principles. Swiss government information records the 57 km Gotthard Base Tunnel entering operation in 2016, providing context for long deep tunnels. Crossrail published a post-construction geological section in 2017, explaining limitations from borehole density, offset and simplified faults. These publication milestones show why explain cutter life using trajectories, contact loads and wear evidence requires original observations to be preserved separately from interpretations. Landmarks provide contextual comparisons only; this course reconstructs public principles.
facts: 教學量化備忘：假設刀位半徑5 m、轉速4 rpm，切向速度v=2πrn/60=2.094 m/s；不代表建議轉速。~Teaching quantitative note: Assume cutter radius 5 m and rotation 4 rpm; tangential speed v=2πrn/60=2.094 m/s, not a recommended speed.
教學量化備忘：假設推進30 mm/min、轉速3 rpm，每轉進尺p=10 mm/rev；未提供刀具容許荷重。~Teaching quantitative note: Assume advance 30 mm/min and rotation 3 rpm; penetration p=10 mm/rev, without specifying allowable cutter load.

教學量化備忘：假設扣除非切削阻力後有效推力10 MN分到40刀，平均250 kN/刀；不等於每刀實際受力。~Teaching quantitative note: Assume effective cutting thrust 10 MN after removing other resistance, shared by 40 tools; the mean is 250 kN/tool, not each tool's actual load.
教學量化備忘：假設平均扭矩2 MN·m、轉10圈、開挖20 m³，E=2πTn/V=6.283 MJ/m³，僅旋轉部分。~Teaching quantitative note: Assume mean torque 2 MN·m, 10 revolutions and excavation 20 m³; E=2πTn/V=6.283 MJ/m³ for rotation only.
教學量化備忘：假設徑向磨耗3 mm歷經600 m，平均0.005 mm/m；此率不能無條件外推到下一岩層。~Teaching quantitative note: Assume radial wear 3 mm over 600 m; mean rate is 0.005 mm/m, not transferable unconditionally to the next stratum.

教學量化備忘：假設正常溫度40°C、觀測65°C，升幅25 K；此差只供教學診斷，不是通用軸承警戒值。~Teaching quantitative note: Assume normal temperature 40°C and observation 65°C; the rise is 25 K, a diagnostic illustration rather than a universal bearing alarm.
